phrases.arabic: يَا مَنْ تُحَلُّ بِهِ عُقَدُ الْمَكَارِهِ ،
phrases.english: 1.O He through whom the knots of detested things are untied!

phrases.arabic: وَيَا مَنْ يُفْثَأُ بِهِ حَدُّ الشَّدَائِدِ،
phrases.english: 2.O He through whom the cutting edge of hardships is blunted!

phrases.arabic: وَيَا مَنْ يُلْتَمَسُ مِنْهُ الْمَخْرَجُ إلَى رَوْحِ الْفَرَجِ ،
phrases.english: 3.O He from whom is begged the outlet to the freshness of relief!
4.Intractable affairs yield to Your power,
5.means are made ready by Your gentleness,
6.the decree goes into effect through Your power,
7.and all things proceed according to Your desire.
8.By Your desire they follow Your command without Your word
9.and by Your will they obey Your bans without Your prohibition.
10.You art the supplicated in worries
11.and the place of flight in misfortunes;
12.none of them is repelled unless You repellest,

phrases.arabic: وَلا يَنْكَشِفُ مِنْهَا إلاّ مَا كَشَفْتَ.
phrases.english: 13.and none is removed unless You removest.

phrases.arabic: وَقَدْ نَزَلَ بِي يا رَبِّ مَا قَدْ تَكَأدَنيَّ ثِقْلُهُ ،
phrases.english: 14.Upon me has come down, My Lord, something whose weight burdens me

phrases.arabic: وَأَلَمَّ بِي مَا قَدْ بَهَظَنِي حَمْلُهُ ،
phrases.english: 15.and upon me has fallen something whose carrying oppresses me.
16.Through Your power You hast brought it down upon me
17.and through Your authority You hast turned it toward me.
18.None can send away what You hast brought,
19.none can deflect what You hast turned,
20.none can open what You hast closed,
21.none can close what You hast opened,
22.none can make easy what You hast made difficult,
23.none can help him whom You hast abandoned.
24.So bless Muhammad and his Household,

phrases.arabic: وَافْتَحْ لِي يَا رَبِّ بَابَ الْفَرَجِ بِطَوْلِكَ ،
phrases.english: 25.open for me, my Lord, the door of relief through Your graciousness,
26.break from me the authority of worry by Your strength,
27.confer the beauty of Your gaze upon my complaint,
28.let me taste the sweetness of benefaction in what I ask,

phrases.arabic: وَهَبْ لي مِنْ لَدُنْكَ رَحْمَةً وَفَرَجاً هَنِيئاً
phrases.english: 29.give me from Yourself mercy and wholesome relief,

phrases.arabic: وَاجْعَلْ لِي مِنْ عِنْدِكَ مَخْرَجاً وَحِيّاً.
phrases.english: 30.and appoint for me from Yourself a quick way out!

phrases.arabic: وَلا تَشْغَلْنِي بالاهْتِمَامِ عَنْ تَعَاهُدِ فُرُوضِكَ وَاسْتِعْمَالِ سُنَّتِكَ.
phrases.english: 31.Distract me not through worry from observing Your obligations and acting in accordance with Your prescriptions.

phrases.arabic: فَقَدْ ضِقْتُ لِمَا نَزَلَ بِي  يَا رَبِّ ذَرْعاً ،
phrases.english: 32.My capacity has been straitened, my Lord, by what has come down on me,

phrases.arabic: وَامْتَلاتُ بِحَمْلِ مَا حَـدَثَ عَلَيَّ هَمّاً ،
phrases.english: 33.and I am filled with worry by carrying what has happened to me,

phrases.arabic: وَأنْتَ الْقَادِرُ عَلَى كَشْفِ مَا مُنِيتُ  بِهِ ،
phrases.english: 34.while You hast power to remove what has afflicted me
35.and to repel that into which I have fallen.

phrases.arabic: فَافْعَلْ بِي ذلِـكَ وَإنْ لَمْ أَسْتَوْجِبْهُ مِنْكَ ،
phrases.english: 36.So do that for me though I merit it not from You,
37.O Possessor of the Mighty Throne!
